scenario_notes: Campaign 2 Session 20 PC-only route_sentence_units_to_hubs routing gate (legacy: Stage B). Must-route rows cover explicit named C2 PC mentions, affected/listener PCs, and **joint party** beats where **the group** / **the team** / **Questionable Company** / **rest of the group** denotes the PCs acting or deciding together (L16·7, L22·1, L24·9, L26·1, L26·3, L30·2, L30·3, L34·2, L34·3 → all six PC slugs where listed). **L34·1** (“Caelynn continues to wait on the line… as the rest of the group set up… camp”) is a **Caelynn-thread** beat: **`caelynn`** only; background camp prep does not promote to whole-party routing. **Rubric realign 2026-05-02:** `u-L0034-01` and **`u-L0032-09`** (operator handoff / Tealeaf line) — GM judgment: Caelynn scene-owner rows; `unit_routing_context.active_scene_owner_hubs=["caelynn"]` stabilizes B1 against empty-hub flakes. **L14·3** — swarm threatens/envelops Caelynn while **the rest of the team** observes → gold **`caelynn`** only. Realign 2026-05-01: accept the model’s stable Caelynn ownership; the observation phrase is not enough to make the beat a full-roster retrieval row. **L18·2-L18·4** continue Bonogo’s guided search beat via clear Bonogo/Stuart "they" antecedents → `bonogo` must_route. **L18·8** (Stuart / Stacey gold accusation) and **L22·7** (post-escalation “more furious”) remain **Bonogo alley / field scene** beats → `bonogo` must_route. **L24·1-L24·2** continue Marla’s direct confrontation with Bonogo via clear "him/he" antecedents → `bonogo` must_route. **L26·6** Marla approaches Caelynn about dealing with Bonogo while Ephanna intervenes; Marla stays session NPC (`missing_entity_bucket=npc_placeholder`). B1 gold uses `explicit_pc`: `direct_pc_slugs` are **caelynn, ephanna** (the active scene/role PCs) and `topic_pc_slugs` is **bonogo** (the decision topic). B2 still routes Caelynn + Bonogo + Ephanna via the reducer union. **B1-CONTENT realign 2026-05-01:** this is role-specific gold, not “all involved PCs in every slug field.” **L28·2** (Sara / operator voice on Caelynn’s call) → **`must_route` `caelynn`** (Caelynn-thread listener; not abstain in PC-only routing). **L30·5** (“She finds Lysandra…”) → Caelynn as perceiver → `caelynn` must_route. Focal-PC-only rows elsewhere keep tight `max_extra_hubs`. Continuation pronouns route to a PC only when that PC is still the clear subject or object of the beat; a following clause about another NPC (e.g. “she” = Marla after Stafl was mentioned earlier) is abstain unless a PC is named again. Thrin, Stuart, Stacey, Marla, Lysandra, Sara, Tealeaf, and locations without a named PC in the unit stay out of PC hubs unless must_abstain says otherwise; named out-of-manifest entities may use needs_new_hub_candidate per runner rules. L22·2 names only Ephanna + Karesmine + Caelynn → gold stays three hubs; recap spelling **Karesmine** = hub **karsemine**. L24·7 is Bonogo + Caelynn only (no whole-party). L28·9 is Caelynn + Karsemine (lead-the-team), not all six. Party band labels load from `corpus/eldyrwild-markdown/Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/_party_registry.json` into `routing_context.pc_party_names` at run time; the PC-only manifest is also exposed as `routing_context.pc_roster_slugs` so party-name rows are copy-from-roster decisions (optional `input.pc_party_names` still merges as harness-only override; not a grader field). **Rubric realign 2026-04-27:** L28·2 and L30·3 were incorrectly `must_abstain`; they are now `must_route` (`caelynn` only; full roster respectively) per GM judgment — see verify-before-debug / corpus rationale (not model-output deflation). **Rubric realign 2026-04-29:** L18·3, L18·4, L24·1, L24·2, and L26·6 were realigned after cross-checking B1/B2 gold against the sentence text and session NPC negative evidence; this tightens the contract rather than matching an arbitrary model output. **Schema cleanup 2026-04-29:** the retired `pc_plus_missing_npc` label is now represented as the specific PC mode plus additive `missing_entity_bucket`; B1 gold may use `*_any` only where preserving legacy artifacts is intentional. **`input.unit_routing_context` (2026-04-29):** eval-only per-unit discourse hints merged into `sentence_units[].routing_context` by the Stage B harness for falsification (“declared discourse state fixes B1”); not live planner corpus provisioning — discovery-not-provision still applies to production flows. **Rubric realign 2026-05-01:** L18·5, L18·7, L18·10, L20·1, and L20·8 were `must_abstain`; GM judgment treats them as Bonogo-scene/thread continuations → `must_route` `bonogo` (corpus rationale; not model-output deflation). **Rubric realign 2026-05-01:** L26·5 (“The mayor and sheriff congratulate the heroes…”) is a full-party retrieval beat; move `u-L0026-05` from `must_abstain` to full-roster `must_route`. **Rubric realign 2026-05-01:** `u-L0016-03` is Karsemine-owned; Caelynn is only local scene context for the swarm position.
